A_question: Can an institutional technical manual or aligned original establish equivalence of nominal XML literal NO VOTAN and senator present-but-explicitly-not-voting in 2025 XV legislature?

B_rivals.H1: literal mapping evidenced in institutional first-party schema
B_rivals.H0: mapping not evidenced in bounded inquiry
B_rivals.H_other: institutions distinguish participation states while public XML may differ from internal SVE interface

C_discriminant: Five preregistered targeted searches for XML literal/schema and at most three primary-source opens; require direct literal+semantics+format/version evidence. Textual ambiguity is not accepted as evidence of identity.

E_observations.title: Pliego de prescripciones técnicas, renovación del sistema de conferencias y votación del Senado
E_observations.observed: The Senate procurement PDF discusses internal electronic voting system (SVE) and Gelabert exchanging XML. The file-layout specifications are described as a confidential document available to bidders under conditions, PDF physical page 3 (extracted P2 lines 82–87). This is evidence of restricted detailed internal exchange formats in this tender, not proof that the separate publicly distributed XML schema is confidential.

At physical page 25 (extracted P24 lines 821–827), the SVE seat map distinguishes Sí/No/Abstención/Presencia via distinct colors; page 24 states a temporarily absent President gets no recorded vote, page 25 (extracted P24 lines 813 and 821-827). The document does not specify how these categories serialize in the public 2025 nominal XML.

Senate displays initiative-level XML download links in XV legislature; webpage inspected contains no machine-field value dictionary establishing NO VOTAN exact semantics. No linked XML downloaded in this bounded cycle.
General parliamentary dictionary defines abstention but not the exact XML token-to-presence mapping; therefore not independent confirmation of H1.
Catalogue identifies Senate XML vote-by-initiative datasets, X–XV, and access URL for XV, but does not in the retrieved description define exact NO VOTAN token.

F_adversarial.alternative: Tender internal SVE/Gelabert exchanged XML versus publicly published XML are different interfaces; one cannot transfer token definitions without a documented transformation.
F_adversarial.technical_warning: Presence shown on seat map could include multiple operational conditions, not a proof of expressed non-vote for each nominal row.
F_adversarial.scope: Search absence does not prove absence of a definition elsewhere. Text extract is not validated through requested visual screenshots (timeouts). Neither source alone proves 2025 version.

G_confirmation.next_required: Obtain publicly releasable Senate XV XML field dictionary/XSD with explicit token enumerations, and cross-check a named session XML against contemporaneous official attendance/vote record. Do not request or redistribute tender-confidential materials.

H_update.prior_change: Adds primary evidence of distinct operational categories and gated historical internal exchange-spec documents; does not change prior caution
